message.content: {"thought": "Now I have a clear picture of the bottleneck candidates. The FFN1 tilings (layer 323-330) dominate latency with ~2.84s each, are purely compute-bound (99.9% compute time), and account for massive energy. The FFN2 tilings (layer 356-371) are on the critical path with ~10.57s end times, also compute-dominated but with significant memory/communication energy. The norm2/res2/res1 layers are memory/communication-bound but have small latency. The critical path ends at layer0_norm2. The low core utilization (45.5%) and imbalance suggest communication/synchronization overhead. I have sufficient evidence to identify the bottleneck candidates. Let me also quickly check the hardware config to understand the chiplet layout and see if NoP/DRAM bandwidth is a factor.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "summarize_hardware_config", "arguments": {"include_design_space": true}}}
